subject: sociology
title: Migration Adventure
welcome_lead: People have always moved — UK story too. ✈️
meta_desc: Globalisation & Culture Adventure 2 — KS3 Sociology on migration and UK society.
final_note: You learned about migration types and how it has shaped the UK.

concepts.def: Movement of people to a new place

walkthroughs.body_html:
People migrate for many reasons:

  • Push factors — war, poverty, persecution.
  • Pull factors — jobs, family, safety.

UK has welcomed migrants for centuries:

  • Huguenots 1600s.
  • Irish 1800s.
  • Windrush from 1948 — Caribbean workers rebuilding post-war Britain.
  • EU workers 2004–2020.

Migration brings:

  • New skills and businesses.
  • Cultural diversity.
  • Some pressure on housing and services.

Refugees fleeing war (Syria, Ukraine) deserve protection by law. 🕊️
